baseline_mechanisms: Collision-dependent addition of actin monomers to exposed filament ends
Independent incorporation activity at each accessible filament end
baseline_assumptions: Monomer concentration does not appreciably change during the short measurement
All counted filament ends are equally accessible and polymerization competent
Actin nucleotide state and solution conditions are fixed
Capping, severing, branching, and depolymerization are negligible for the gross incorporation measurement
scientific_constraints: The gross incorporation rate must be nonnegative
Incorporation requires both competent monomers and exposed filament ends
The response must be nondecreasing in each sampled input under baseline conditions
refinement_agenda: Add reversible monomer loss from filament ends and model the net assembly rate
Include end capping and uncapping
Allow monomer sequestration by actin-binding proteins
Introduce branching-generated filament ends or time-dependent monomer depletion

domain_mechanisms.description: finite receptor occupancy or saturating signal transduction
